description: Check the LIVE status of an order — real production stage (from the Enfocus Switch print workflow), ready-for-pickup, or shipped with carrier + tracking (from StarShipit, authoritative). Look up a real order by number (e.g. #119581) or a quote/draft by number (e.g. #D776755). Requires the customer's email, which must match the order. Use for 'where is my order', 'track order 12345', 'is my order ready'. Shipped/delivered from StarShipit is final; otherwise the live Switch stage is returned.

email.description: alternatively, the customer's email to list recent orders (requires verified identity)

name: vivid_order_status
